title: eddy_openmp
description: A tool for correcting eddy currents and movements in diffusion data

imain.description: File containing all the images to estimate distortions for
imain.title: imain

index.description: File containing indices for all volumes in --imain into --acqp and --topup
index.title: index

bvecs.description: File containing the b-vectors for all volumes in --imain
bvecs.title: bvecs

bvals.description: File containing the b-values for all volumes in --imain
bvals.title: bvals

mb_offs.description: Multi-band offset (-1 if bottom slice removed, 1 if top slice removed)
mb_offs.title: mb_offs

slspec.description: Name of text file completely specifying slice/group acuistion. N.B. --slspec and --json are mutually exclusive.
slspec.title: slspec

json.description: Name of .json text file with information about slice timing. N.B. --json and --slspec are mutually exclusive.
json.title: json

mporder.description: Order of slice-to-vol movement model (default 0, i.e. vol-to-vol
mporder.title: mporder

s2v_lambda.description: Regularisation weight for slice-to-vol movement. (default 1, reasonable range 1--10)
s2v_lambda.title: s2v_lambda

topup.description: Base name for output files from topup
topup.title: topup

field.description: Name of file with susceptibility field (in Hz)
field.title: field

field_mat.description: Name of rigid body transform for susceptibility field
field_mat.title: field_mat

flm.description: First level EC model (movement/linear/quadratic/cubic, default quadratic)
flm.title: flm

slm.description: Second level EC model (none/linear/quadratic, default none)
slm.title: slm

fwhm.description: FWHM for conditioning filter when estimating the parameters (default 0)
fwhm.title: fwhm

residuals.description: Write residuals (between GP and observations), (default false)
residuals.title: residuals

fep.description: Fill empty planes in x- or y-directions (default false)
fep.title: fep

interp.description: Interpolation model for estimation step (spline/trilinear, default spline)
interp.title: interp

s2v_interp.description: Slice-to-vol interpolation model for estimation step (spline/trilinear, default trilinear)
s2v_interp.title: s2v_interp

nvoxhp.description: # of voxels used to estimate the hyperparameters (default 1000)
nvoxhp.title: nvoxhp

initrand.description: Seeds rand for when selecting voxels (default 0=no seeding)
initrand.title: initrand

ff.description: Fudge factor for hyperparameter error variance (default 10.0)
ff.title: ff

repol.description: Detect and replace outlier slices (default false))
repol.title: repol

ol_nstd.description: Number of std off to qualify as outlier (default 4)
ol_nstd.title: ol_nstd

ol_nvox.description: Min # of voxels in a slice for inclusion in outlier detection (default 250)
ol_nvox.title: ol_nvox

ol_type.description: Type of outliers, slicewise (sw), groupwise (gw) or both (both). (default sw)
ol_type.title: ol_type

ol_pos.description: Consider both positive and negative outliers if set (default false)
ol_pos.title: ol_pos

ol_sqr.description: Consider outliers among sums-of-squared differences if set (default false)
ol_sqr.title: ol_sqr

estimate_move_by_susceptibility.description: Estimate how susceptibility field changes with subject movement (default false)
estimate_move_by_susceptibility.title: estimate_move_by_susceptibility

mbs_niter.description: Number of iterations for MBS estimation (default 10)
mbs_niter.title: mbs_niter

mbs_lambda.description: Weighting of regularisation for MBS estimation (default 10)
mbs_lambda.title: mbs_lambda

dont_sep_offs_move.description: Do NOT attempt to separate field offset from subject movement (default false)
dont_sep_offs_move.title: dont_sep_offs_move

dont_peas.description: Do NOT perform a post-eddy alignment of shells (default false)
dont_peas.title: dont_peas

data_is_shelled.description: Assume, don't check, that data is shelled (default false)
data_is_shelled.title: data_is_shelled
